messages.subject: getting widgets to span columns inside mainPanel of pageWithSidebar
parts:
I have a widget in the mainPanel of a pageWithSidebar.  It only spans the first half of the mainPanel, and I would like it to span all of the mainPanel.  I have tried putting it inside of a column() call, like

column(8,uiOutput('myChoices'))

but that doesn't seem to change things one bit.
